subheadline.default: Global Financial Strategy, M&A and Capital Governance

bioParagraph1.default: Over more than two decades in international finance and the energy sector, I have built experience across corporate headquarters and complex international operations, with assignments spanning India, Nigeria, Italy, Kenya, South Africa and Iraq.

bioParagraph2.default: My career has encompassed financial leadership, corporate reporting, planning and performance management, joint ventures, governance, capital allocation and transaction support across international upstream oil & gas operations.

bioParagraph3.default: Working across different countries, cultures and organisational settings has taught me to connect corporate strategy with operational realities while maintaining financial discipline and effective governance. Today, that experience shapes how I approach M&A, capital allocation, financial strategy, risk and controls, technology-enabled finance and enterprise performance.

capabilitiesLead.default: I collaborate closely with executive leadership to craft proactive financial frameworks, moving beyond simple financial reporting to accelerate business planning, sustainable expansion, manage international exposure, and maximise the enterprise value.

philosophyQuote.default: “Effective strategic financial leadership relies on vision. It requires building agile frameworks that allow organisations to pivot smoothly, capture emerging market opportunities, and turn complexity into a competitive advantage. Financial leadership is not about backward-looking compliance.”
